rows.en:
I see… Juro Minami from Unicorn's Japan Branch is a buddy of mine from college soccer!

Besides… the pro soccer league is a place where players and supporters dream together.

I won't forgive BF's methods, tearing those dreams apart in one stroke!

I'll rescue the hostages safely and smash their operation to pieces!
All right, that's the spirit! Go get 'em!!
Terrorism using a giant creature… The enemy must be a pretty powerful organization.
I hope Shocker and the Neo-Human Empire don't take advantage of this commotion to make a move…
We're going too… right?
Of course we are, [HERO2]!! Come on, let's go!
Yeah, yeah…
Is the televised public search still going on?
Yeah. It looks like the kaiju vanished somewhere around here.

I see… But a place that could hide that many hostages…

It'd be another story if there were a huge basement somewhere, but anyway, let's split up and search. The two of us will head south. Goro, you and the others check the north!
Okay, got it!
Hm… So you've shown up, Neo-Human Empire!
There you are, Shocker!
We've got no time to deal with these guys right now! If we don't finish this fast, we're in trouble!
…This is U7. Japan Branch, please respond.
This is Japan Branch. What is it, U7? Did you find something?
I've found an island that's clearly artificial! I'm going down to investigate.
Got it. Be careful!
Eh, eh, eh, eiii, eiiiiii!!
Ah, what's that!?
What's wrong, U7!? Respond!

…I'm fine, Marie. It just startled me a little.

A bat monster showed up on the artificial island! I knew this island was suspicious. I'm going down to take a closer look!
Okay, got it. I'll contact Minami, U3, and have him look into that island.
Roger!
This is Japan Branch… U7, do you read me?
This is U7! Go ahead…

Minami and the others are engaging BF! But they didn't find the hostages over there.

Also, there's been a sighting of someone who looks like the BF Chief at Haneda Airport, and Nishino, U5, is investigating that.
Then what are the chances the hostages are here?
High! We've also had sightings of the electric kaiju Sparky around there.
What!? But Giant Robo can't sortie… What should I do?

Ah, wait a second!

U7… The TDF is requesting that you join up with the Riders fighting nearby!

Can you see them from there?

Kamen Rider, huh… I wonder if they'll notice me.

Okay, I'll give it a try! I'll try contacting them.

A bat monster on the island to the southwest…? All right, got it!

I'm Daisaku Kusama! I'm U7 of Unicorn's Japan Branch.

Giant Robo can't sortie, and we don't know where the hostages are…

Ah, it's the electric kaiju Sparky! That means…

the hostages are on the artificial island! All right, I'll take it down!
